transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because my mood has been completely out of control for about a year and two months now. I have this overflowing energy where I feel incredibly high and happy, but then I suddenly get extremely irritable and angry over the smallest things. It's like I'm constantly shifting between being on top of the world and being furious.
During these episodes of high energy or irritability, have you ever experienced any break from reality, such as hearing voices or seeing things that aren't there?

Yes, I do hear voices and see things that aren't actually there, which can be really terrifying. However, this only happens when I'm in those super high-energy or really irritable phases. When my mood is normal or flat, I never experience those things at all.
How long do these episodes of high energy or irritability, accompanied by the break from reality, typically last?

These episodes have actually been going on continuously for about a year and two months now. I haven't really had a break from this cycle of high energy and unusual experiences during this entire time.
Do the breaks from reality, such as hearing voices or seeing things, ever occur without the high energy or irritability, or are they always tied to those mood episodes?

They are always tied to those mood episodes. I only ever experience those voices and visions when I am in that high-energy or irritable state. When my mood is stable or normal, those things never happen.
Can you estimate what percentage of the time you've spent in these abnormal mood episodes over the past year and two months, versus times when your mood was relatively stable or normal?

I'm not really sure of an exact percentage, but it feels like these high-energy, fast-paced moods have been happening almost constantly over the last year and two months. There have been very few moments where I felt truly normal or stable.

Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you experienced significant psychotic symptoms, such as hallucinations or delusions, without a major mood episode, or have the psychotic symptoms always occurred in conjunction with your mood episodes?

No, I have never experienced those hallucinations or delusions without the mood episodes. They are always tied directly to my high-energy or irritable states. I've never had a time where I heard or saw things when my mood was normal or stable.

Can you tell me more about the times when you feel furious or irritable - are these episodes also accompanied by depressive symptoms, such as feelings of sadness, hopelessness, or loss of interest in activities?

No, I don't experience those depressive feelings like sadness or hopelessness at all. When I get furious, it's just pure anger and frustration, not feeling down or losing interest in things. My energy stays really high even when I'm angry.
Are your episodes of high energy and irritability distinct and separate from each other, or do they sometimes blend together or switch rapidly back and forth?

They definitely blend together and switch back and forth incredibly fast. I can go from feeling completely ecstatic and full of energy to suddenly being furious at the slightest thing in a matter of seconds. It's a very rapid, unpredictable cycle where they often happen at the same time.
Can you describe any patterns or triggers that you've noticed for these rapid mood shifts, or if there are any specific events, people, or situations that tend to precede or follow these episodes?

There aren't any specific triggers, events, or people that cause these shifts. They are completely unpredictable and just happen out of nowhere. I will suddenly go from feeling intensely euphoric and full of energy to being extremely angry and irritable without any clear reason at all.
Have you ever experienced a period where your mood was stable, but you still had psychotic symptoms like hallucinations or delusions, or do these symptoms only occur when your mood is unstable?

No, those symptoms only occur when my mood is unstable. I have never experienced hallucinations or delusions during any period when my mood was stable or normal. They are strictly tied to my high-energy and irritable states.
